01 ELECTRICAL SCHEMATIC
REV R1 | DATE 2026-11-20
DRAFT, NOT FOR SUBMISSION
Pi 5 GPIO, ULN2003, LEDs, buttons, kill switch, toggle. All voltages labelled.
A. RASPBERRY PI 5 GPIO HEADER (40 PIN) - 3.3V LOGIC ONLY, NOT 5V TOLERANT

Used inputs: GPIO17, 27, 22, 23, 24. All active LOW, internal pull-up, gpiozero, debounce 0.05 s (kill 0.02 s).
Used outputs to ULN2003: GPIO5, 6, 13, 19, 20, 21. Spare input GPIO26 to ULN2003 IN7.
ASSUMED: GPIO20 / GPIO21 for button LEDs are lead decisions, not in the original brief. See ARCHITECTURE sec 9 gap.
B. ULN2003AN DIP-16, 7 CH DARLINGTON, SINK ONLY
ULN2003, PIN 1 TOP LEFT, NOTCH UP
1 IN1 GPIO5 --- 16 OUT1 COORD
2 IN2 GPIO6 --- 15 OUT2 AGENT1
3 IN3 GPIO13 --- 14 OUT3 AGENT2
4 IN4 GPIO19 --- 13 OUT4 GUARD
5 IN5 GPIO20 --- 12 OUT5 GRN LED
6 IN6 GPIO21 --- 11 OUT6 RED LED
7 IN7 GPIO26 SPARE --- 10 OUT7 SPARE
8 GND to GND --- 9 COM to 5V
COM pin 9 to 5V, NOT to GND. GND pin 8 to GND.
GPIO HIGH turns LED ON. Output pulls to GND.
500 mA per channel max. 6 LEDs about 60 mA total.
SOURCING RISK: DigiKey TI ULN2003AN out of stock,
12 week lead. Newark stock LIKELY only. See BOM.csv.
Fallback if no ULN2003: status LEDs direct
from GPIO at 3.3V, button LEDs dark. Core not blocked.
C. LED BRANCHES, 5V RAIL
Path: 5V - resistor - LED anode - LED cathode - ULN2003 OUT - GND.
Formula: R = (5.0 - Vf - Vsat) / I. Vsat = 1.0 V ASSUMED.
COORD green GPIO5 / OUT16
100 ohm | Vf 3.0V ASSUMED
I = (5-3.0-1.0)/100 = 10.0 mA ASSUMED until Vf measured
AGENT 1 red GPIO6 / OUT15
220 ohm | Vf 2.0V ASSUMED
I = (5-2.0-1.0)/220 = 9.1 mA ASSUMED until Vf measured
AGENT 2 blue GPIO13 / OUT14
100 ohm | Vf 3.2V ASSUMED
I = (5-3.2-1.0)/100 = 8.0 mA ASSUMED until Vf measured
GUARD yellow GPIO19 / OUT13
220 ohm | Vf 2.0V ASSUMED
I = (5-2.0-1.0)/220 = 9.1 mA ASSUMED until Vf measured
GREEN BTN LED GPIO20 / OUT12
220 ohm * | Vf ASSUMED, see note
I about 9-10 mA ASSUMED ASSUMED until Vf measured
RED BTN LED GPIO21 / OUT11
220 ohm * | Vf ASSUMED, see note
I about 9-10 mA ASSUMED ASSUMED until Vf measured
* Button LEDs: EG STARTS 5V LED, built-in resistor
ASSUMED. If plain LED, add 220 ohm. Test with meter first.
Resistor power: I squared x R about 0.02 W. 1/4 W is fine.
Colour map ASSUMED: order from old blueprint
green/red/blue/yellow mapped in order to
COORD/AGENT1/AGENT2/GUARD. Confirm in build.
D. INPUTS, ALL TO GND, ACTIVE LOW, INTERNAL PULL-UP, 3.3V ONLY
GREEN BTN: GPIO17 P11 to switch, GND P14. Approve. On start screen only: pick 2020.
RED BTN: GPIO27 P13 to switch, GND P20. Reject. On start screen only: pick 2022.
KILL NC: GPIO22 P15 to switch, GND P25. NC closed = LOW = normal. Open = HIGH = FROZEN. Fail safe.
PTT: GPIO23 P16 to switch, GND P14 *. Momentary. Hold to talk. * GND pin ASSUMED, use any GND.
TOGGLE LANG: GPIO24 P18 to switch, GND P20 *. SPST latching. EN open / ZH closed, or reverse in code.
Never connect a button or switch to 5V. Pi GPIO is not 5V tolerant. VERIFIED.
Kill poll: every 100 ms in bridge. Do not rely on edge only.
ULN2003 input at 3.3V: test first. Datasheet does not promise full saturation at 3.3V. ASSUMED risk.
If a channel is dim or warm, use TBD62083A or logic MOSFET per LED. LIKELY alternative.
Nets: 3.3V logic = Pi header pins 1 and 17. 5V = pins 2 and 4. GND = pins 6, 9, 14, 20, 25, 30, 34, 39.
ASSUMPTIONS
* All resistor values ASSUMED until LED Vf is bench measured. W3 values used: red/yellow 220 ohm, green/blue 100 ohm, button LEDs 220 ohm if plain.
* Vsat 1.0 V ASSUMED. Vf red/yellow 2.0 V, green 3.0 V, blue 3.2 V, all ASSUMED typical values.
* GPIO20 pin 38 and GPIO21 pin 40 for button LEDs are lead decisions, not in the original brief.
* GPIO26 pin 37 spare channel IN7 tied to GND ASSUMED. Do not leave it floating in final build.
* Button LED built-in resistor ASSUMED for EG STARTS parts. Verify with multimeter before wiring.
* ULN2003 DigiKey stock 0, 12 week lead. Newark stock LIKELY only. Sourcing risk, not a drawing error.
* ULN2003 at 3.3V input is test first, not guaranteed. See ARCHITECTURE sec 0 item 7.
